Priced Right. Presented Well. Sold.

Pricing, preparation, and presentation — done thoughtfully so your home stands out and sells for what it's worth.

What Selling a Home Actually Takes

Most sellers I work with are juggling a lot — figuring out timing, preparing the home, and planning what comes next. My job is to make the selling side of that as organized and straightforward as possible.

What you can expect

Strategic Pricing

I analyze local trends, buyer behavior, and comparable sales to position your home where it attracts the strongest interest.

Smart Preparation

Not every update is worth making before you list. I help you figure out which improvements actually move the needle — and which ones don't.

Maximum Exposure

Your listing goes out through Coldwell Banker's national network, MLS, and targeted digital campaigns — but I also know who buys in La Jolla and how to reach them directly.

Skilled Negotiation

When offers come in, the price is just the starting point. I help you evaluate the full picture — terms, contingencies, and buyer strength — so you make the best decision, not just the fastest one.

Clear Communication

ou'll always know where things stand. I don't wait for you to ask — I keep you updated at every stage so there are no surprises and no wondering what happens next.

The selling process

  1. ONE

    Strategy & Pricing

    We look at what's sold nearby, what's currently competing with your home, and what buyers in this market are actually responding to — then set a price that attracts serious offers.

  2. TWO

    Preparation

    We figure out exactly what to fix, stage, and photograph — and what not to bother with — so you spend money where it actually counts.

  3. THREE

    Launch & marketing

    Professional photography, online exposure, and targeted outreach to qualified buyers.

  4. FOUR

    Offers & Negotiation

    When offers come in I help you read beyond the price — evaluating financing, contingencies, and timing — so you choose the offer that actually closes.

  5. FIVE

    Escrow to close

    I track every deadline, coordinate with all parties, and keep you updated so nothing stalls between acceptance and the day you hand over the keys.

Common seller questions

When is the best time to list?
Honestly, it depends on your situation more than the calendar. Spring tends to be active in San Diego, but I've seen well-prepared homes sell well in any month. We'll look at what's happening in your specific neighborhood and build a timeline that works for you.
Do I need to renovate before selling?
Not always. Often, targeted improvements and presentation choices create the best return without over-investing.
How do we handle showings and privacy?
We can tailor showing windows, notice periods, and guidelines. The goal is strong buyer access without disrupting your life more than necessary.

Thinking about selling?

If you’re considering a move, I’ll help you understand your options and what the current market looks like for homes like yours.
